claims.author: kravens
claims.harm: The lookup budget does not count block and undo reads, allowing queries that fit in the 50 MiB budget to read far more disk than intended.
claims.quote: The lookup budget does not count block and undo reads. At verbosity 2, tx_to_json reads the full block and its undo data for every block that holds a non-coinbase match

claims.author: kravens
claims.quote: OrderedVarInt could be BigEndianFormatter<3>. Big-endian already sorts by height, and the same key already uses it for the tx offset.
claims.request: Use BigEndianFormatter<3> instead of introducing OrderedVarInt.

claims.author: kravens
claims.quote: Ordering spenders doesn't need a block read. txospenderindex keys already store a CDiskTxPos, and its nTxOffset grows with the transaction's position in the block.
claims.request: Sort extra spenders by (height, tx_offset) using CDiskTxPos from txospenderindex instead of reading full blocks.

claims.author: kravens
claims.quote: Find could take the whole set of script hashes. Today the RPC calls Find once per hash and merges results by (height, tx_offset).
claims.request: Have Find take the whole set of script hashes to avoid duplicate transaction reads and simplify post-processing.

claims.author: kravens
claims.quote: One budget, one error. Index lookups charge a uint64_t& and fail with "Script history index lookup limit exceeded…". Extra transaction bodies throw a std::runtime_error
claims.request: Unify index-layer and RPC-layer budget enforcement and error reporting into a single type.

claims.author: kravens
claims.quote: Could the RPC go in its own file? blockchain.cpp grows by ~530 lines to 4,238. The handler is one ~400-line lambda that opens with a 12-step index comment.
claims.request: Move getscripthistory RPC handler into its own file (src/rpc/scripthistory.cpp) with one function per step.

claims.author: kravens
claims.harm: Declaring TxToJSON in rawtransaction_util.h violates library boundaries because the header belongs to bitcoin_common while TxToJSON takes a Chainstate and is defined in bitcoin_node.
claims.quote: TxToJSON is now declared in rawtransaction_util.h. That header belongs to bitcoin_common, which the wallet also links. TxToJSON takes a Chainstate and is still defined in rawtransaction.cpp in bitcoin_node.
